desc:
💾 Things took a wicked turn. We were warned that the animatronics tend to get a bit quirky sometimes—but this? This was unexpected. I barely made it out alive. My friends, on the other hand, weren't so lucky..
[ > recovered from video log #7 - corrupted data ]

📂 Survivor Files:
Survive the night by completing objectives to unlock the blast doors, your only chance of escape. Will you ensure that everybody makes it out alive, or is it every man for himself?

⚠️ Animatronics:
If it weren’t for them, you would’ve never turned into the monster you are today. 
Nobody makes it out alive. 

Original by Scott Cawthon.
This fan-made unofficial game is created by huge fans as a tribute to celebrate the game and share our passion with the community.
